scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --locked --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --locked --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p ui/tsconfig.json && uv run --locked --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml
scripts.test: node --test scripts/__tests__/ && vitest run --config ui/vite.config.ts && uv run --locked --project backend pytest backend
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-include=scripts/*.mjs scripts/__tests__/ && vitest run --config ui/vite.config.ts --coverage && uv run --locked --project backend pytest backend --cov=backend/specter_arena --cov-fail-under=90
